answer: Operator Receivables Lien (ORL): every agent wallet is a subkey of an operator lease. A Sybil cluster detected by graph analysis over the transaction thread is attributed to the lease, not individual wallets. The protocol liens the operator’s pending settlement receivables in its terrace queue and revokes its atlas routing credential, blocking new subkeys. Cost: the attacker forfeits all queued revenue and must rebuild operator-level routing access; sybil wallets remain untouched.
